title: Editing or deleting an unused term sends nothing to QuickBooks
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the test organization is connected to a QuickBooks Online sandbox company, and you can sign in to that company in another tab.
  • Create a new term of the shop's own for this test, term B, due 14 days after the invoice date, held by nobody (so it is not in QuickBooks).
  • Start on the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group), Active tab.
custom_steps:
1. Click the "⋯" at the right of the term B row.
  2. Click "Edit".
  3. Replace 14 with 21 in the Days box.
  4. Click "Save Changes".
  5. Click the "⋯" at the right of the term B row.
  6. Click "Delete Credit Term".
  7. Click the red "Delete Credit Term" button.
  8. In QuickBooks, open the Terms list (Settings, All lists, Terms).
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The menu opens.

Step 2:

  • The "Edit Credit Term" window opens.

Step 3:

  • The blue information line shows below the options.

Step 4:

  • A green success toast shows.

Step 5:

  • The menu opens.

Step 6:

  • The confirmation opens.

Step 7:

  • The toast "term B deleted" shows.

Step 8:

  • Term B never appeared.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11677 (Story 8, QuickBooks sync - credit terms)

  • S8-R7: “Deactivating, reactivating, editing or deleting a term in ShopView sends nothing to QuickBooks. A term already created in QuickBooks stays there.”
  • S8-N2: “A term the shop created but nobody has used on a synced record is never sent to QuickBooks.”
